evidence_rule: No empirical panel may be rendered from placeholder, simulated, hand-entered, or selectively filtered outcomes. Every panel must bind its aggregation code and source artifact hashes.

panels.content: One real source-span to atom-DAG worked example with dependencies and F/S retain/drop coloring.
Forward information-flow timeline from source/task freeze through public development, private terminal scoring, analysis, and release; V3, V4, V5, and the forward extension remain visibly separate.
Compact admission state machine showing F sufficient/insufficient, S sufficient/insufficient, orthogonal Invalid checks, and control roles.

figures.claim: Protocol transparency and leakage control, not an empirical effectiveness result.

panels.content: Paper-task forest/dot-whisker display of paired S-F private-score differences, six raw paired blocks, and descriptive paired-block intervals.
Paper-task by condition/model faceted heatmap with Admit, Reject, and Invalid kept distinct; provider/model facets are never collapsed into a five-dimensional cell.

figures.claim: Registered-benchmark heterogeneity and coverage; no random-sample population claim.

panels.content: Compression-reliability-cost Pareto scatter using retained atom ratio, retained token ratio, operational success, private score, input/output tokens, and elapsed time.
Dependency-respecting atom restore/drop trajectories for the four frozen ladder clusters, with each registered level shown even when Invalid.

figures.claim: Secondary mechanism evidence on four clusters only. Cross-task points are normalized within cluster before aggregation.

panels.content: SLA threshold grid and leave-one-block-out decision stability; baseline, sufficiency, and paired-margin thresholds vary only over the registered grid.

Failure-mode decomposition separating no submission, hard-contract failure, score shortfall, budget exhaustion, recovered transport retry, terminal transport failure, unavailable model, and integrity failure.

figures.claim: Robustness and operational diagnosis; recovered transport retries are not counted as semantic failures.

conditional_outputs.name: control_confusion_matrix
conditional_outputs.render_gate: At least eight independent task-level positive controls and eight independent task-level negative controls must be registered before outcomes.
conditional_outputs.current_output: Exact task-level control table with binomial intervals and no calibrated-error-rate claim.

statistics.nesting: six paired blocks within task, two tasks within paper, three papers within each of four domains
reporting: Exact counts and denominators for every state.
All six raw paired block outcomes for every paper-task cluster.
10,000-replicate paper-cluster bootstrap sensitivity intervals with both tasks and all blocks carried together.

cluster_bootstrap.resample: papers with replacement independently within each domain
cluster_bootstrap.preserve: both tasks and all matched blocks for a sampled paper

per_task_intervals.success_counts: Clopper-Pearson interval shown only as six-block descriptive uncertainty
per_task_intervals.score_differences: paired bootstrap over the six registered blocks with raw points always visible
per_task_intervals.forbidden_interpretation: Neither interval supports IID paper, task, model, or user population inference.

sla_sensitivity_grid.leave_one_block_out: For each omission, scale count thresholds by ceiling(5*n/6) and keep the registered paired margin.

model_analysis.method: Report each model slot separately with the same paper-task rows, state counts, and paired effects.
model_analysis.unavailable_models: Visible as unavailable, never deleted or replaced post hoc.

multiple_testing.primary: No candidate selection from private outcomes; one primary S per cluster.
multiple_testing.secondary: Model, atom-ladder, control, and threshold analyses are explicitly secondary and cannot rescue a failed primary result.
multiple_testing.p_values: No null-hypothesis p-value is required for the finite admission rule; any exploratory p-value must be labeled and multiplicity adjusted.

statistics.missing_data: Invalid or unavailable rows remain in registered denominators; no complete-case analysis may replace the primary report.

Direct threshold and reject-option precedent; EffectSlice does not inherit distribution-free guarantees.
Direct benchmark-analysis precedent; the exact five-factor decomposition is new to this experiment.
